senses.gloss:
प्रतृद् 1. प्र-तृद्, cl. 7. P. A. -तृणत्ति,
तृन्त्ते, -तर्दितुम्, Ved. to thrust through with a
spit, spit, pierce.

2. प्र-तृद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. splitting up, piercing; (त्),
m. an expression substituted for the name of Tṛtsu.

प्रतृप् प्र-तृप्, Caus. P. -तर्पयति, -यि-
तुम्, to satisfy, sate, satiate; to refresh, invigorate,
strengthen.

प्रतॄ प्र-तॄ, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.), 6. P.
-तरति (-ते), -तिरति, -तरितुम्, -तरीतुम्, to cross
over, pass over, be ferried across; to come for-
wards, advance, thrive, prosper (Ved.); to lead for-
wards, lead, conduct; to promote, further, cause to
thrive or prosper; to augment, aggrandize, enhance,
raise, elevate; to lengthen, prolong, extend (fre-
quently with आयुस्, in the sense of ‘prolonging
life’); (A. with आयुस्), to live longer: Caus. -तार-
यति, -यितुम्, to lengthen, spread, extend; to mis-
lead, misguide, cheat, deceive; to lead astray, seduce;
to induce, persuade.

प्रातृद प्रातृद, अस्, m. a patronymic from
Pra-tṛd.
